subject.title: fix(deps): keep worker tooling on patched releases

question: Should Crabhelm accept this coordinated Cloudflare worker-tooling upgrade after confirming the updated lockfile removes the intended Sharp resolution and preserves the supported build/test path?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes executable worker tooling and transitive platform packages; deciding that the compatibility evidence is sufficient is a maintainer judgment rather than an automated cleanup decision.

options.title: Validate and proceed
options.body: Run the stated worker compile, dry-run build, and test workflow against the updated lockfile, verify the Sharp resolution, then mark the draft ready if results are clean.

options.title: Keep current versions
options.body: Leave the existing worker toolchain in place if the updated packages introduce an incompatibility or the vulnerability path is not actually resolved.

recommendation.title: Validate and proceed
recommendation.body: Run the stated worker compile, dry-run build, and test workflow against the updated lockfile, verify the Sharp resolution, then mark the draft ready if results are clean.
